name: [1.20] v3.0.1 (Forge)
changelog:
1.20 and 1.20.1 release! Changelog:  
- Chests with vanilla loot tables will contain the new armor trims.  
- Clay pot rooms now use the new decorated pots. And can rarely have decorations already on them!  
- Added sand and suspicious sand to now randomly spawn in the floors of rooms on the bottom floor of the temple.  
- Buffed pharaoh HP from 20 to 60.  
- Reworked the bottom floor's room distribution placement to greatly minimize the chance of weird generation such as completely empty rooms without floors and doorways with a wall behind it.  
- Mining fatigue now applies every 5 seconds instead of every 1 second, making cheesing with milk buckets a bit more feasible.
